rationale: The aim is local improvement with rapid learning on two wards. PDSA cycles let the team test the round first without the float nurse, then with it, then with touch-based assessment, while charts of patient-days between injuries (suited to rare events) show whether the interval lengthens. Night staffing is a stratifier (c1), the change idea has precedent (c2), and the outcome is measured by weekly inspection because incident reports undercount (c3). Reporting follows SQUIRE 2.0.
alternatives: Controlled comparison of wards with and without the round (refused: two wards, no funding, local improvement question)
Board-level campaign for a mandated ratio (refused: the retrieved evidence shows an association, and the quoted study is untraced)
whyNotMoreComplex: A controlled design would need more wards and months of stable delivery; the local question is whether these two wards can protect night repositioning and see fewer injuries.

decision.statement: Test a protected night repositioning round with handover risk reassessment on wards 7A and 7B in PDSA cycles from November 2026, measuring patient-days between category 2 or worse injuries found at weekly skin inspection, stratified by night staffing.
decision.question: Should wards 7A and 7B test a protected night repositioning round to reduce pressure injuries?

criteria.text: Night staffing is associated with injuries, a protected round has been followed by fewer injuries elsewhere, and weekly inspection gives an undistorted measure.
The hospital introduces a mandated night ratio on these wards during the project.

gates.requirement: Quality committee registration of the project as quality improvement
gates.evidence: Registration QI-2026-054 dated 2026-09-02, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Night bank agreement to release a float nurse when the ratio is worse than one to seven

alternatives: Round without a float nurse only
Touch-based assessment training without a protected round
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c3 from retrieved records; neither the quarantined lead nor the unverified landmark lead is cited. The float nurse gate is unknown, so the action stays blocked.

summary: QI with PDSA cycles recommended; the decision rests on three ledger claims and waits for the night bank's agreement.
